description: Header file defining structures and classes related to UE SRB context and PDCP processing in 5G RRC layer, including security configuration, PDCP result handling, and context management.

classes.name: ue_srb_context
classes.description: Manages SRB context including security setup, PDCP packing/unpacking, and reestablishment.

methods.name: enable_tx_security
methods.description: Configures transmission security parameters for the SRB.

methods.name: enable_rx_security
methods.description: Configures reception security parameters for the SRB.

methods.name: enable_full_security
methods.description: Enables full security (integrity and ciphering) for the SRB.

methods.name: pack_rrc_pdu
methods.description: Packages an RRC PDU into a PDCP PDU, returning success or failure.

methods.name: unpack_pdcp_pdu
methods.description: Deciphers and verifies integrity of a PDCP PDU, returning unpacked PDUs or error cause.
